name: Core Assets Corp.
summary: Core Assets Corp. functions as an exploration-focused entity, concentrating its efforts on the procurement, examination, advancement, and appraisal of mineral resource assets. The company primarily seeks to uncover deposits containing valuable metals such as copper, cobalt, silver, and gold. Its principal holding is the expansive Blue property, which spans approximately 108,337 hectares located in the southwestern region of Atlin, British Columbia. Established in 2016, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Vancouver, Canada.
